reason: Adds a terminal-based interactive profile for DeepSeek Harness with continuous agent conversations, streamed tool activity, local file references, and inline tool-call approvals.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供纯终端交互式聊天界面，支持多轮会话、流式响应、文件引用和工具调用授权。
summaries.en: Provides a terminal-based interactive chat profile for DeepSeek Harness with multi-turn sessions, streaming responses, file references, and tool-call approvals.

capabilities: Runs an interactive terminal chat interface for DeepSeek Harness
Streams assistant reasoning, responses, and tool calls
Allows inline approval or rejection of agent tool calls
Browses and attaches referenced text files from the working directory
Supports model, preset, and permission switching
